project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite, TypeScript (strict), Zustand state management, Supabase backend
build_system: npm + Vite. Root Makefile delegates to frontend/. tsconfig uses path alias @/ -> src/. strict mode with noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters.
test_framework: vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom. Tests colocated in __tests__/ dirs. Engine tests in src/engines/__tests__/, store tests in src/stores/__tests__/, component tests in src/components/<Module>/__tests__/
build_command: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
test_command: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run. 3. All 517+ tests must pass.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. Use 'unset NODE_OPTIONS' before running npx commands due to sandbox proxy bootstrap issue.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. Node 22.23.2 with npm available. Must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running node/npm commands. No Docker daemon available for testing. Supabase queries are mocked in tests.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode. All new code must pass tsc --noEmit. Tests are mandatory for new features. Follow existing patterns: engines are pure functions with EngineError throws, stores use zustand create(), components use inline styles, tests mock @/lib/supabase.
key_patterns: Engines: pure functions, no side effects, throw EngineError on failure, types in types.ts. Stores: zustand with separate State/Actions interfaces, use fromTable() for DB queries. Components: functional, inline styles, data-testid attributes. Tests: vi.mock for supabase, describe/it/expect pattern.
directory_structure: frontend/src/ contains: engines/ (pure calculation modules), stores/ (zustand state), components/ (React UI organized by feature), types/ (TypeScript interfaces), lib/ (supabase client), pages/ (route pages), canvas/ (Konva canvas), hooks/
